answer: Fresh accounts sit on a low ridge of trust, so mass-created identities gain almost nothing until they accumulate costly, peer-attested contributions. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted harbor bonds: each agent must lock a bond before earning, and reputation slot weight scales with the plume of verified work history rather than raw registrations. Attackers must burn real capital and sustained effort across many accounts, making forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
